title: chore: refresh staging economics ingest token
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Refreshes the encrypted local Economics ingest value to the current Tinybird staging `operations_ingest` token.
- Changes no Tinybird token, scope, or production credential.
- Verifies only `TINYBIRD_OPS_INGEST_TOKEN` changed and that the stored token can read the staging ledger.

gist.headline: Staging nectar refreshed
gist.blurb: The economics ingest worker received a fresh staging token and checked it against the ledger. Production bees were not disturbed.
gist.summary: Refreshed the encrypted `TINYBIRD_OPS_INGEST_TOKEN` used by the Economics staging ingest pipeline and verified it can read the staging ledger without changing production credentials or token scope.
gist.impact: Staging economics ingestion keeps working with the current Tinybird `operations_ingest` credential while production access remains unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed operations scene: Polli, wearing a tiny locksmith apron, carefully replaces a key on a labeled staging ledger terminal while a separate production hive jar remains safely untouched. The key represents the refreshed encrypted ingest credential; sprouts and flowers make the internal maintenance feel calm rather than dramatic.
